references.text: God's original instructions to Moses to make forty silver sockets under the twenty boards, with two sockets under each board for its two pegs. Exodus 36:24 describes the fulfillment of this command.
Parallel instruction regarding silver sockets under the tabernacle boards, showing the consistent pattern of construction.
Describes the amount of silver used to cast the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil, a total of one hundred talents of silver.
Moses sets up the tabernacle and places the sockets in position, demonstrating the final assembly of the components made in chapter 36.
The responsibility of the Gershonites included the boards, bars, pillars, and sockets of the tabernacle, showing the continued use of these elements.
The task of the Merarites was to carry the boards, bars, pillars, and sockets of the tabernacle during the journey through the wilderness.
The fulfillment of God's specific instructions in the construction of the tabernacle walls.
The direct instruction underlying the described execution.
